applies_to: Neptronic EVCB14N VAV controllers with four triac outputs that drive an external damper motor, pressure independent (IT4X) or dependent (DT4X).
summary: This variant of the EVCB14N drives an external damper actuator instead of the built-in one, and talks BACnet MS/TP with a fixed object table similar to the standard EVCB14N. Points cover zone temperature, setpoints, demands, airflow and triac output configuration. Some objects are not available on the pressure-dependent EVCB14NDT4X.
notes: Object availability varies by sub-model; the source marks each object per model.
Multistate state lists depend on other configuration objects.
Airflow values are listed without units; scaling depends on the controller configuration.
Some airflow objects are not available on the pressure-dependent EVCB14NDT4X.

source.title: EVCB14NxT4X BACnet Communication Module User Guide

integration.summary: Read the zone temperature, setpoint, demands and airflow, and drive occupancy with MSV.11. To control from a BMS space temperature, set MSV.4 to Network Sensor and keep writing AV.1 ControlTemp faster than the NetworkTimeOut period (AV.145).

minimum_points.name: NsbOccCommand
minimum_points.why: BMS occupancy / night setback / off command

minimum_points.name: Cfg_TempControlSource
minimum_points.why: Select internal, external or network temperature

minimum_points.name: ControlTemp
minimum_points.why: Control temperature; written by the BMS when the source is Network Sensor

integration.enable: Occupancy and off are commanded with MSV.11 NsbOccCommand: Locally (wired input/sensor decides), Occupancy, No Occupancy (night setback) or OFF. Changeover can also be forced by the BMS through MSV.3 Cfg_ChangeOverControlMode.
integration.heartbeat: AV.145 NetworkTimeOut (0-60 min): when the temperature source is Network/Remote and the BMS has not written a temperature within this time, the EVC goes to OFF and AV.1 shows 999°C in fault. Setting it to 0 makes AV.1 fall back to the AV.15 setpoint value instead.
integration.remote_sensors: Set MSV.4 Cfg_TempControlSource to Network Sensor; AV.1 ControlTemp then becomes writable and must be refreshed by the BMS (see AV.145).
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; the device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC address (auto) and can be changed from the menu or by writing the Device Object_Identifier.
MAC address defaults to 0; baud rate auto-detects (9600/19200/38400/76800), or set it by writing Device proprietary property 1001.
Max_Master defaults to 127; lower it to the highest MAC on the trunk for faster token passing.
A Copy Config function in the menu can clone one controller's configuration to others of the same type on the trunk.
gotchas: Out_of_Service on read-only objects is writable for testing, but it reverts automatically after 15 minutes (Device proprietary property 1002, 0-120 min, 0 = never).
Many multistate objects only offer some states depending on other configuration objects; read State_Text from the device.
Cfg_ objects are commissioning parameters; avoid writing them cyclically from the BMS.
Airflow objects show "No units"; the value follows the airflow scale set on the controller (MSV.41 Cfg_AirFlowScale where present).

points.name: Cfg_MotorRamp
points.description: Ramp used to modulate the damper actuator based on demand
points.states: Cooling Ramp1 Cooling Ramp2 Heating Ramp1 Heating Ramp2 AirflowSetPoint* Changeover Ramp Cooling Heating Ramp 1 Analog * not available with EVCB14NDT4X | central unit (cool or heat) which is given by the changeover signal in order to match signal to the airflow setpoints (see analog and/or digital input settings for changeover). The slave controller must be set to pressure independent and will convert the 0-10Vdc from the master to match the airflow setpoint. If a changeover is required for the master, it will also be required for the slave controller. Maximum and minimum cooling/heating Airflow setpoints are also required to operate correctly. Changeover Ramp (Cor): This ramp is used when the central system does both heating and cooling. It requires a changeover sensor to operate. The ramp is configured with AV.56 Changeover Proportional Band and AV.57 Changeover Dead Band. When the zone is in cooling demand, the EVC will modulate the damper actuator between the minimum and maximum cooling airflow setpoints (AV.102 and AV.103). When the zone is heating demand, the EVC will modulate the damper actuator between the minimum and maximum heating airflow setpoints (AV.104 and AV.105). Cooling Heating Ramp 1 (CH1): This ramp is used when central system does cooling only and a reheat coil is present at the zone level. The ramp is configured with AV.21 Heating Proportional Band 1, AV.22 Heating Dead Band 1, AV.41 Cooling Proportional Band 1 and AV.42 Cooling Dead Band 1. When the zone is in cooling demand, the EVC will modulate the damper actuator between the minimum and maximum cooling airflow setpoints (AV.102 & AV.103). When the zone is heating demand and a heating output is active, the EVC will modulate the damper actuator between the minimum and maximum heating airflow setpoints (AV.104 & AV.105). Analog (0-10Vdc): This ramp is used to set the VAV box as a slave controller. The damper actuator follows the 0-10Vdc signal received by analog input 1 or 2 when MSV.1 or MSV.2 is set to motor position.
